name: +1 Hair Escape✂️
desc:
✂️ +1 HAIR ESCAPE ✂️

    HOW TO PLAY:
💇 Grow your hair +1 at a time, and train on treadmills to grow it even FASTER
🎯 Aim your hair across giant gaps to reach the next platform
🚡 Zipline down your own hair and hook onto anchors high above the drops
🌎 Escape through wild worlds: icy glaciers, Candyland, Neon Tokyo, Crystal Caverns and more!
🏆 Collect Wins to unlock epic hair like Lava, Galaxy and Lightning
🔁 Rebirth for huge boosts, climb the leaderboards and flex the longest hair on the server!

One bad throw can drop you back to your last checkpoint... how long does YOUR hair need to be? 😱

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE so you never miss a new world, and join the GROUP for updates!
